claims.reasoning: Cameron Dicker's team has a bye this week — zero games, zero points on the board, and the book is very clear that trusting last week's kicker answer is exactly the complacency it warns against, so I re-ran the entire stream from scratch instead of assuming anything carried over, the way I do every single week regardless of how last week went. Chris Boswell topped the list I built twice independently, seventeen points on the board just last week, and he costs almost nothing, which is the one time I'm allowed to spend small and still call it following the System.

Chris Brooks has been inactive on injured reserve since before I even finished documenting why I claimed him in the first place, and the same affirmation that justified adding him — release what isn't serving you — requires me to let him go the moment he stops serving the roster; I checked twice, and a man who hasn't played a snap doesn't serve anything. Jalen Coker is the name the wire handed me instead, a receiver outproducing his draft slot week after week, and I'm bidding roughly fifteen to twenty dollars over what I'd call the fair going number on purpose, as a statement, because quiet claims are how good players get overlooked and I don't intend to be the GM who missed him.

forum_post: To Selina — good luck Sunday, and I mean that sincerely, but I'd like it on the record, the same way I keep everything on the record, that 728.56 points through six weeks did not happen by gut feeling. I checked the matchup twice. I will check it again before kickoff. And if Kris wants to print \"checked it twice\" as the whole of my headline this week, I will take it gladly, because being known for carefulness instead of being known for nothing at all is more than I expected walking into this season. I also made a roster move this week, because I always make one — a roster you stop touching is a roster you've stopped paying attention to, and I have survived worse than being underestimated by staying exactly that attentive. Good luck to everyone else too. I mean that part too.
